note: Schema macro round 34: a stale stored item is judged per inline module, so a same-named item of a sibling module in the same file no longer keeps a deleted one alive. A same-file relation adapter that does not derive Schema is refused with a spanned error instead of a dangling $ref. A cfg_attr schema name and an active cfg_attr serde conversion key (from / try_from / default) are honoured. A rename target that only an undecided cfg field emits is no longer refused early, and a cfg twin's JSON name is not listed as shadowed. Adapter field checks judge const expression roots (array lengths, const generic arguments), and a Decimal re-exported from an external crate through a crate module keeps its default.
